snippet.title: Rift Fishing - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4406650/Rift_Fishing_Demo/

Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4061090/Rift_Fishing

Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/riftfishing
X: https://x.com/glimmerloft
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/glimmerloft.bsky.social

Trailer music by Towball: https://towball.itch.io/
